Twemoji API 17.0.3, vendored from the `@twemoji/api` npm package.
Source: https://github.com/jdecked/twemoji
JavaScript: MIT (see LICENSE). SVG artwork: CC BY 4.0.
Artwork is loaded from the pinned 17.0.3 jsDelivr URL by news-emoji.js.
If an image fails to load, the original Unicode emoji remains visible.
